disclosure_contract.enforcement: A future semantic card-session owner filters the presentation snapshot. Hide labels, geometry, tooltips, legends, matrix cells and plots consistently; no UI-only reveal switch. Existing standalone math_lab explorers remain ungated sandboxes.

components.name: Matrix board
components.contract: Rectangular arrays; real, complex or GF(2) domains; structural zero versus measured small value; block boundaries; pivot/permutation overlays; paired numeric/structural views.
components.gap: Current matrix diagrams hold nine values. Add a separately bounded viewport/tiling model and variable-shape data; do not enlarge 3D primitives per entry.

components.name: Vectors, bases and linear maps
components.contract: Ordered bases, arrows, coordinate representations, spans, residuals, transformed disk/sphere, decomposition stages and explicit metric.
components.gap: Extend beyond the present real 3-by-3 explorer: rectangular domain/codomain and complex/high-dimensional numeric views. Any projection into 3D must name what is omitted.

components.name: Functions, bases and samples
components.contract: Declarative basis functions, given sample nodes, candidate coefficients, residuals, derivative/integral traces and fitting domain.
components.gap: Replace fixed example functions with per-card basis definitions and exact sample data; finite samples cannot certify an infinite-dimensional subspace claim.

components.name: Inner products and quadratic geometry
components.contract: Declared Gram matrix, candidate vectors, norm/angle data, affine quadratic forms, level sets, tangent/gradient and distance constructions.
components.gap: General symmetric metrics, oblique coordinate frames, linear terms and non-Euclidean orthogonality are not all exposed by existing presets.

components.name: Spectra and the complex plane
components.contract: Eigenvalues, singular values, complex-plane probes, perturbation contours, polynomial matrix functions and comparison bands.
components.gap: Current roots/Gaussian objects do not compute arbitrary matrix spectra or pseudospectra. Add an independent complex numerical owner and explicit domain masks.

components.name: Evolution and convergence
components.contract: Snapshots by step/time, true error versus residual, directions, scalar rates, thresholds, seeds and repeatable experiment metadata.
components.gap: Reuse plot/time UI; add each actual algorithm or validated result input. The current oscillator kernel is not a general matrix-exponential or eigensolver.

components.name: Precision, work and experiments
components.contract: Representation bins, perturbation/error scales, operation counts, sample distributions, parameter sweeps and measured timings.
components.gap: Separate observed timings, analytical counts and estimates. No synthetic timings; no fixed n=3 substitute for n=60 or n=100 cards.

components.name: Sampling and spectral discretization
components.contract: Node coordinates, weights, interpolation bases, derivative operators, boundary conditions, complex error fields and resolution comparisons.
components.gap: The 21-by-21 display patch is not a discretization solver. Add genuine periodic/Chebyshev operators and distinguish solver resolution from display sampling.

components.name: Incidence, parity and dependency graphs
components.contract: Typed vertices/edges, matrix-index links, parity bits, syndromes, path weights and disjoint pair stages.
components.gap: Generalize the fixed graph layouts. GF(2) parity is exact arithmetic; Markov probabilities and real geometric dot products are different domains.

components.name: Meshes, coordinates and physical fields
components.contract: Nodes/bars/faces, supports, coordinate maps, vector/scalar fields, trajectories, boundary conditions, density and mesh/result identity.
components.gap: Add arbitrary domains and validated field samples. Spherical harmonics do not supply disk/cube eigenmodes; a sculpted vibration shape is not an eigenproblem result.

components.name: Assumptions and licensed steps
components.contract: Given statements, named dependencies, implication edges, candidate steps and local justification prompts.
components.gap: A visual example illustrates a theorem; it is not a proof checker. Preserve source gaps and a separate human/key review state.

components.name: Composition and computation flow
components.contract: Typed input/output shapes, ordered factors, reusable intermediates, active computational step and optional work count.
components.gap: One declared domain-action owner supplies results to every view. Shape checking and step semantics must live outside presentation.
